purpose: Create a club with valid leadership and faculty assignments.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Valid student and faculty records are available.
action_or_input: Submit a club name and description, an allowed category, two valid student leaders, and a valid Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: The club is created with open status and successful creation is confirmed.

purpose: Verify that an invalid student leader assignment does not create a club and can be corrected.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
At least one selected leader is not a valid student record.
action_or_input: Submit the club with an invalid coordinator or co-coordinator, then correct the assignment.
expected_result: The invalid assignment is identified; no club is created from the invalid submission, and correction can proceed.

purpose: Verify that an invalid faculty assignment does not create a club and can be corrected.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
The selected Club Faculty Councillor is not a valid faculty record.
action_or_input: Submit the club with the invalid faculty assignment, then correct it.
expected_result: The invalid assignment is identified; no club is created from the invalid submission, and correction can proceed.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Club category
purpose: Verify the specified club categories are accepted and a category outside the allowed set is not accepted.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Valid student and faculty records are available.
action_or_input: Submit otherwise valid club data using Technical, Sports, and Cultural categories; also attempt a category outside that set.
expected_result: Each specified category is accepted; the out-of-set category is not accepted as a club category.

purpose: Verify failed storage does not create a partial club.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Valid club data is supplied.
Required data cannot be stored.
action_or_input: Submit the valid club data while storage of the required data fails.
expected_result: No club is created and the system reports failure.

purpose: Approve an open club.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
The club exists with open status.
action_or_input: Open the club record, review its recorded information and assignments, and approve it.
expected_result: The club status changes from open to confirmed and approval is confirmed.

purpose: Verify a club that is not open is not approved.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
The club exists and is not open.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the club.
expected_result: No approval transition occurs and the club retains its prior status.

purpose: Verify a failed club update does not change club status.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
The club exists with open status.
The status update cannot be stored.
action_or_input: Approve the club while its update fails.
expected_result: No approval transition occurs and the club retains its prior status.

purpose: Book a club session in a configured venue with no conflicting booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The venue is configured and the requested slot has no conflict.
action_or_input: Submit a date, configured venue, start time before end time, description, and optional poster.
expected_result: The session is stored, notification to intended student recipients is initiated, and the booking is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 Alternative Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Booking overlap
purpose: Reject a session overlapping an existing session in the same venue and date.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
An existing session overlaps the requested slot in the same venue and date.
action_or_input: Submit the overlapping session booking.
expected_result: The booking is rejected, the actor is asked to select another slot, and no session is accepted.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 Alternative Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Booking overlap
purpose: Reject a session overlapping an existing event in the same venue and date.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
An existing event overlaps the requested slot in the same venue and date.
action_or_input: Submit the overlapping session booking.
expected_result: The booking is rejected, the actor is asked to select another slot, and no session is accepted.

purpose: Reject a session booking with an invalid venue.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The selected venue is invalid.
action_or_input: Submit a session booking using the invalid venue.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Booking time
purpose: Reject a session whose start time does not precede its end time.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The requested start time is at or after the end time.
action_or_input: Submit the session booking with the invalid time range.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify a session is not accepted when storage fails.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The requested booking is otherwise valid.
Session storage fails before acceptance.
action_or_input: Submit the session booking while storage fails.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify a session is not accepted when notification processing fails before acceptance.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The requested booking is otherwise valid.
Notification processing fails before acceptance.
action_or_input: Submit the session booking while notification processing fails before acceptance.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

purpose: Book a club event in a configured venue with no conflicting booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The venue and faculty context are valid and the requested slot has no conflict.
action_or_input: Submit an event name, faculty context, date, configured venue, start time before end time, poster, and description.
expected_result: The event is stored, notification to intended student recipients is initiated, and the booking is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 Alternative Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Booking overlap
purpose: Reject an event overlapping an existing event in the same venue and date.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
An existing event overlaps the requested slot in the same venue and date.
action_or_input: Submit the overlapping event booking.
expected_result: The booking is rejected, the actor is asked to select another slot, and no event is accepted.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 Alternative Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Booking overlap
purpose: Reject an event overlapping an existing session in the same venue and date.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
An existing session overlaps the requested slot in the same venue and date.
action_or_input: Submit the overlapping event booking.
expected_result: The booking is rejected, the actor is asked to select another slot, and no event is accepted.

purpose: Reject an event booking with an invalid venue.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The selected venue is invalid.
action_or_input: Submit the event booking using the invalid venue.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

purpose: Reject an event booking with an invalid faculty reference.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The faculty reference is invalid.
action_or_input: Submit the event booking with the invalid faculty reference.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Booking time
purpose: Reject an event whose start time does not precede its end time.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The requested start time is at or after the end time.
action_or_input: Submit the event booking with the invalid time range.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify an event is not accepted when it cannot be stored.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club is confirmed.
The requested event is otherwise valid.
Event storage fails.
action_or_input: Submit the event booking while storage fails.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

purpose: Apply for membership in a confirmed club.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
The selected club exists and is confirmed.
Student has no application to that club.
action_or_input: Select the confirmed club and submit achievements or an application description.
expected_result: A new open application is recorded for the authenticated student and submission is confirmed.

purpose: Allow a student with an existing application to apply to a different club.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
An application by the student exists for a different club.
The selected club exists and is confirmed.
action_or_input: Apply to the selected club with achievements or an application description.
expected_result: A new open application is recorded for the selected club; the existing application remains unchanged.

purpose: Reject a duplicate application to the same club.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
An application by the student already exists for the selected confirmed club.
action_or_input: Submit another application to that same club.
expected_result: The duplicate is rejected and the existing application remains unchanged.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Membership applications
purpose: Verify membership applications are limited to confirmed clubs.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
The selected club exists with open status.
action_or_input: Attempt to apply for membership in the open club.
expected_result: No membership application is created for the club.

purpose: Approve a pending membership application for the actor's club.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
An open application exists for the club.
action_or_input: Select the open application for approval and optionally enter remarks.
expected_result: The application status changes from open to confirmed, any entered remarks are stored, and success is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 Alternative Flow; UC-GYM-005 Exception Flow
purpose: Verify bulk approvals are evaluated independently.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
Selected applications include one open application for the actor's club, one no longer open application, and one application for another club.
action_or_input: Select all three applications for approval in one interaction.
expected_result: The eligible open application is confirmed; the no-longer-open and other-club applications are unchanged.

purpose: Create and notify a poll with the minimum number of choices and a valid target audience.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
Valid batch and branch target information is available.
action_or_input: Submit a poll title, description, expiration date, two choices, and valid batch and branch targets.
expected_result: An active poll with its choices and target audience is created, selected target-group students are notified, and creation is confirmed.

purpose: Create a poll targeting all branches for a selected batch when that option is configured.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The all-branches option is configured for the selected batch.
action_or_input: Create a poll with valid choices and select the configured all-branches target for the batch.
expected_result: The poll is created with the selected batch's all-branches audience, and that audience is notified.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Poll choices
purpose: Reject poll creation with fewer than two choices.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
Valid target information is available.
action_or_input: Submit a poll with fewer than two choices.
expected_result: The poll is not created and is not treated as successfully created.

purpose: Reject poll creation with invalid target information.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator.
The supplied target information is invalid.
action_or_input: Submit a poll with at least two choices and invalid target information.
expected_result: The poll is not created and is not treated as successfully created.

purpose: Cast one vote in an active poll as an eligible student who has not voted.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
Poll is active and unexpired.
Student belongs to a target group.
Student has not voted in the poll.
action_or_input: Select one of the poll choices and submit the vote.
expected_result: One vote is recorded, the poll tally is updated, the student is recorded as having voted, and success is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Poll voting
purpose: Reject a second vote from the same student in the same poll.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
Poll is active and unexpired.
Student belongs to a target group and has already voted in the poll.
action_or_input: Submit another vote in the poll.
expected_result: The vote is rejected and the tally remains unchanged.

purpose: Reject a vote from a student outside the poll's target audience.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
Poll is active and unexpired.
Student is not in a target group and has not voted.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a vote in the poll.
expected_result: The vote is rejected and the tally remains unchanged.

purpose: Reject a vote in a poll that is not active.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
Poll is not active or is expired.
Student has not voted in the poll.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a vote in the poll.
expected_result: The vote is rejected and the tally remains unchanged.

purpose: Change the club coordinator and co-coordinator to valid students.
preconditions: Actor is an applicable current Club Head.
The club exists.
Both proposed leaders are valid students.
action_or_input: Submit the proposed coordinator and co-coordinator.
expected_result: The club references the new current leaders, superseded current leadership designations are removed or retired, and the change is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Student leaders
purpose: Verify an invalid proposed coordinator does not change current leadership.
preconditions: Actor is an applicable current Club Head.
The club exists.
The proposed coordinator is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit the leadership change with the invalid coordinator.
expected_result: The change fails and existing leadership remains unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Student leaders
purpose: Verify an invalid proposed co-coordinator does not change current leadership.
preconditions: Actor is an applicable current Club Head.
The club exists.
The proposed co-coordinator is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit the leadership change with the invalid co-coordinator.
expected_result: The change fails and existing leadership remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify an unauthorized actor cannot change club leadership.
preconditions: The club exists.
Actor is not an applicable current Club Head.
action_or_input: Submit a leadership change with otherwise valid proposed student leaders.
expected_result: The change fails and existing leadership remains unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 Main Success Scenario; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Budget amount
purpose: Submit a budget request with a non-negative amount at the zero boundary.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head.
The club exists and is confirmed.
A required supporting file is available.
action_or_input: Submit a purpose, amount of zero, supporting file, and description.
expected_result: The request is stored with open status for tracking and submission is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Budget amount
purpose: Reject a budget request with a negative amount.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head.
The club exists and is confirmed.
A required supporting file is available.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with a negative amount.
expected_result: The request is rejected and is not stored as a valid submission.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Budget supporting file
purpose: Reject a budget request without the required supporting file.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head.
The club exists and is confirmed.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with a non-negative amount but no supporting file.
expected_result: The request is rejected and is not stored as a valid submission.

purpose: Submit a documented report for a completed club event.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head.
The relevant event or activity has occurred.
Required report/details file is available.
Club and student incharge references are valid.
action_or_input: Submit the club and student incharge, event name and description, event date and time, and report/details file.
expected_result: The event report is stored in the club repository and successful submission is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Event report file
purpose: Reject an event report missing its required report/details file.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head.
The relevant event or activity has occurred.
Required report information is otherwise valid.
action_or_input: Submit the event report without the required report/details file.
expected_result: The report is not accepted.

purpose: Reject an event report with an invalid required reference.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head.
The relevant event or activity has occurred.
The student incharge reference is invalid.
action_or_input: Submit the event report with otherwise valid required information and file, but an invalid student incharge reference.
expected_result: The report is not accepted.

purpose: Reject an event report with a missing required reference.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head.
The relevant event or activity has occurred.
A required report reference is missing.
action_or_input: Submit the event report with the required report/details file but omit a required reference.
expected_result: The report is not accepted.

purpose: Allow the assigned Club Faculty Councillor to access and review a submitted report.
preconditions: Faculty user is authenticated and assigned as Club Faculty Councillor for the club.
At least one submitted report is available for that club.
action_or_input: Open the club report area, select a submitted report, and request its details file.
expected_result: The club's submitted reports are listed and the selected report metadata and report/details file are available for review.

source_id: UC-GYM-012 Exception Flow; Problem Statement §8 Success Criteria — Assigned councillor access
purpose: Deny report access to a faculty user not assigned to the club.
preconditions: Faculty user is authenticated but is not the assigned Club Faculty Councillor for the club.
At least one submitted report is available for that club.
action_or_input: Open or request the club's submitted reports.
expected_result: Access is denied and no unauthorized report content is exposed.
